title: continuous-batcher: scheduler tuning for queueing fairness and starvation timeouts
author: Avery Chen
description: Context and motivation: Observed queueing starvation in the continuous-batcher under mixed small/large request workloads which caused tail latency regressions for small, latency-sensitive requests. This PR tunes the scheduler to improve queueing fairness and prevent indefinite starvation by introducing aging-based priority adjustments, configurable queue timeouts, and preemption heuristics. Summary of changes: 1) Add configurable max_queue_time_ms and per-tenant aging_factor to the scheduler; requests accrue "age" while waiting and aging boosts effective priority to favor long-waiting requests; 2) Introduce preemption logic: when a request's queue_time exceeds starvation_threshold_ms the scheduler will allow smaller batches to be scheduled or partially preempt larger batches to make progress on starved requests; 3) Add soft and hard queue timeouts (defaults: soft=200ms, hard=1000ms) with eviction logs and metrics; 4) Emit new metrics: continuous_batcher.queue_time_seconds (histogram), scheduler.starvation_count (counter), scheduler.preempt_events (counter), and kv_cache.hit_rate per-model; 5) Expose runtime knobs via k8s config patch and feature flag for staged rollout; 6) Add unit tests and canary perf harness for mixed workloads; 7) Docs: update observability and tuning doc for operators. Backwards compatibility and safety: All knobs have conservative defaults that preserve prior behavior. The preemption path is gated by a feature flag and additional safety checks (max_preempt_fraction) to avoid throughput regressions. Rollout plan: Canary on Dedicated pools (10% capacity) + monitor new metrics; if preempt_events rise above configured alert thresholds, automatically roll back. Testing: unit tests for aging and preemption, integration canary showing ~8% improvement in 95th latency for small requests on mixed workload, manual KV-cache regression checks. Related: ENG-1082, ENG-1100, incident SUP-742. Checklist: [x] unit tests added [x] integration/canary run [x] docs updated [x] metrics dashboards added [x] reviewers approved.
